summary:
Fixed and verified. **PASS.**

The needle was the off-by-one in the pagination offset at `app/app.py:28`:

```python
offset = (page - 1) * per_page - (1 if page > 1 else 0)   # bug
offset = (page - 1) * per_page                            # fix
```

The spurious `- (1 if page > 1 else 0)` shifted every page after the first back by one item, so page 2 started at ID 10 instead of 11 — an overlap that duplicated the last item of the previous page. Removing it makes page boundaries contiguous, and `test.sh` now passes.
